method: Searched public GitHub and social-post collections, fetched fixed-commit README and license content via GitHub public API, screened source-bound editing versus generation recipes, compared against all 134 local style directions, and independently adapted selected text into bounded reference-image recipes. Original upstream images are not used.
license_policy: Preserve the declared upstream license and all credited authors, and distinguish collector declarations from direct author permission. Source-pending SeeAPI entries were excluded. Generation recipes adapted into editing methods are explicitly marked; no upstream before/after validation is claimed.
